about: Model gate (docs/model-upgrade.md, decision 016). Baseline: the installed Flash-Next GSQ-RCO Coder (IQ1_M GGUF, llama.cpp b11284, 96K context, Q4 KV). A suite within one task of a gate's minimum, or one false accept over its maximum, is borderline: repeat that suite once before deciding.

gates.opens: Make the new model the default (no worse than the baseline on small changes).
Reopen feature development: phase 4 (queue, decomposition, objective-check round 2), then phase 5.
Widen the test factory to large modules.
